title: Opening intro
lines: Ink drawings on old paper: a planet.
The Vault symbol.
An alien Vault.
A monster with gaping jaws attacks soldiers.
Purple crystal bursts out.
Crystals spread.
The planet, with a space station above.
Beams from the station. Robots march.
A gunman on a heap of wreckage.
Fighters gather.
Four heroes pose for battle.
Handsome Jack, arms folded.
The drawings fade to black.
A sunlit desert. A billboard shows Handsome Jack waving: Vault Hunters Wanted.
A huge spiked beast prowls past the billboard.
A heavy chain snaps tight around the beast.
Bandits drag the beast off across the sand on the chain.
Masked bandits and a wild-eyed psycho ride in the back of their truck.
The psycho waves madly.
Bandit buggies race across the desert.
The psycho is flung through the air as a buggy flips.
Words on the side of a train: 2K Games presents.
The psycho clambers onto the train roof.
A sign, A Gearbox Software game, knocks him off.
A little robot watches from beside the tracks.
The train races over snowy mountains. Title: Borderlands 2.
Inside the train, a poster: Welcome Vault Hunters, with Jack's grinning face.
Four Vault Hunters ride in the carriage.
Yellow Hyperion loader robots burst in.
Axton, a soldier, fights back and throws down a gun turret.
Title: Axton as the Commando.
Maya, her arm covered in glowing tattoos, traps a robot in a floating bubble.
Title: Maya as the Siren.
Salvador, a short, bearded brute, fires two guns at once.
Title: Salvador as the Gunzerker.
On the snowy train roof, Zer0, a masked assassin, faces a man in a yellow power suit.
Zer0 cuts him down with a glowing sword.
Title: And Zer0 as a number.
The four Vault Hunters stand together, weapons ready.
Elsewhere, a masked man sits among stacks of bombs.
The train explodes over the snow.
